description: A local design system's button: everything eds.button is, plus a link variant. EDS deliberately ships no link-styled button; this team's product needs one. The extension binds only tokens that already exist (the ghost ladder per tone, and concept/text-link for the ink) and the merged contract is emitted and verified like any other.
notes: The ADR-0007 demo extension, the success path. Its sibling fixture (example-info) is the refusal path: extending the tone enum with info fails because the system has no info ghost ladder — the mechanism reports the gap instead of emitting a broken component, and that report is how local needs become upstream requests. Merge notes: the background rides the {tone} ghost ladder (specificity beats the root defaults, exactly like the ghost variant); the link ink is pinned per tone because a variant-wide concrete token ties with the anatomy's tone-interpolated ink and loses on the system's first-added-wins tie-break.
